pr_title: Change visual script round function output type to float

issue_context.title: Round or Switch Bug
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.2.1 stable
**OS/device including version:**
Windows 10
**Issue description:**
For some unknown reason, it doesn't understand that when a float is rounded to an int it should be an int and not still a float. in the example below, i have a vector with (90,0) that i use round on the X value, plug that value in to the switch and if it is an int=90 it should print 90... however it acts like 90!=90 and doesn't print that last print.
**Steps to reproduce:**
use round on any float, plug the int in to a switch, make sure the values are equal on both the round you get out and the switch case you want to run
**Minimal reproduction project:**
[Bug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/4469253/Bug.zip)
comments:
(Related to #19262)

Bug comes from the fact that round is listed as returning "int", but then proceeds to return "double".
